parameters.subject: Welcome To Harwell Home Care!
parameters.bodyContent:
=Hi {{ $('Map Data').item.json.firstname }}, 

We are delighted to welcome you to the Harwell team!  

To successfully manage your role and responsibilities here at Harwell, we give you access to 3 tools:

- Employment Hero: Used for HR, Payroll and Training
- Sandwai: Used for Client Care Management
- Harwell Connect: Used for internal communications
  
You would have already accessed Employment Hero to complete your Onboarding, and now it's time to access the other Tools.


Below are the details for accessing “Sandwai,” your Client Care Management system.

Sandwai is used for things like managing client visits, updating your schedule, availability, and much more.  

Please watch this Sandwai overview: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZdQxNpLkPEM 


You can download the Sandwai app here:  

• iOS: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/sandwai/id1012818302 

• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sandwai.mobile&hl=en  

Your login credentials are:  

- User ID: {{ $('Sandwai CREATE').item.json.data.id || "Please email techsupport@harwell.com.au" }}
- Company ID: 174
- Password: {{ $('Map Data').item.json.password }}
  

As for Harwell Connect (Business & Team Communications), you can access that here: 

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/harwell-connect/id6736431526
Android: Search Google Play store for "Harwell Connect".


Your login credentials are:  

- Email: {{ $('Map Data').item.json.email }}
- Password: Harwell1!


If you encounter any issues downloading or logging in to any tool or platform, you can send an email to techsupport@harwell.com.au
 
If you have any questions regarding your role and responsibilities and how they relate to Sandwai, please reach out to your respective Team Leader. 

Thank you and welcome!

values.content:
=Compare the following data points: Data 1: {{ $('Sandwai GET').item.json.data.address.address }} {{ $('Sandwai GET').item.json.data.address.suburb }} {{ $('Sandwai GET').item.json.data.address.postcode }} {{ $('Sandwai GET').item.json.data.address.state }}

Data 2: {{ $('Map Data').item.json.address.address }} {{ $('Map Data').item.json.address.suburb }} {{ $('Map Data').item.json.address.postcode }} {{ $('Map Data').item.json.address.state }}

Return JSON address_changed. Return False if the address is generally correct or if this is null: ({{ $json.data.address }}). Otherwise return true if the building, street, state or postcode is different.

Example:
Data 1: 22 Smith Street, Darwin, 0810
Data 2: 1/22 Smith St, Darwin, 0810
Returns address_changed: false as only the unit number and the formatting and or spelling are different.
Example: 
Data 1: 22 Smith Street, Darwin, 0810
Data 2: 1/45 Smithh St, Darwin, 0810
Returns true as the building number is different, not just the unit.
Example: 
Data 1: 22 Smith Street, Darwin, 0810
Data 2: 22 John St, Darwin, 0810
Returns true as the street is different, thus not generally correct.
